yellow_findings_detail.summary: new RegExp(`^${label} \(.+\)$`) inside a template literal loses the backslash escape and compiles to a capture group, not a literal paren. Currently unreachable (no importer nav item is role: "button" after placeholder removal), but under-constrains the moment a disabled item returns.
Allowlist entries match by bare expression prefix (e.g. "key.replace(") with no file scoping, so any future file naming a variable `key` could humanize a raw enum and still pass the scan.

IncompleteLineReasonKey is hand-restated (layering rule forbids importing the application-layer source type), so it is the one axis without compile-time exhaustiveness -- a 4th member would compile clean and throw at runtime instead. Honestly documented in the code; a structural tradeoff, not an oversight.

Doc comment describes /onboarding/setup deriving to undefined as a deliberate behavior change, but the page still hard-codes activeNavLabel="Dashboard" -- comment/behavior mismatch only, no functional bug.

reviewer_notes: Independent subagent review, isolated worktree, no memory of implementation conversation.
